reviews.summary: Provided a Reviewed-by tag and indicated that the patch looks good to them.

2026-11-13.patch_summary: This patch series consolidates the logic for determining the watermark that kswapd reclaims zones up to, simplifying the code and removing unnecessary includes. The consolidation is done by introducing a new helper function `kswapd_wmark_pages` which returns either the promo or high watermark depending on whether NUMA balancing memory tiering is enabled.
